1.w: A Psalm of David, in his being in the wilderness of Judah. O God, You [are] my God; I seek after You—my soul thirsts for You, my flesh longs for You—in a land dry and weary, without waters.

2.w: So in the sanctuary I have seen You, to behold Your power and Your glory.

3.w: Because Your loving devotion [is] better than life, my lips will praise You.

4.w: So I will bless You in my life; in Your name I will lift up my hands.

5.w: As [with] milk and fatness, my soul is satisfied, and with lips of joyful shouts, my mouth will praise You,

6.w: when I remember You on my bed, through the watches of the night I meditate on You.

7.w: For You have been a help to me, and in the shadow of Your wings I will shout for joy].

8.w: My soul clings to You; Your right hand has taken hold of me.

9.w: And those [who] seek my soul for desolation, they will go into the depths of the earth.

10.w: They will fall by the hand of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.

11.w: And the king will rejoice in God; everyone swearing by Him will exult, but the mouth of those speaking lies will be stopped up.
